messages:
sam: Noticing a weird pattern from clients over QUIC: connections spin down (server-initiated GOAWAY-like spin) and clients immediately open new QUIC streams with the same resume token. Backend treats them as distinct sessions -> phantom concurrent sessions in billing and session-count panels.

aline: Huh. QUIC path reuse semantics differ from TCP/WS. Any logs or packet traces?

sam: Minimal log snippet:
```
edge-eu | quic_conn=0xabc state=IDLE_SPINDOWN timer=30s send=PATH_CLOSE
client   | new quic stream created id=45 resume=rt_Zx12
server   | create session session_id=sess-77 token=rt_Zx12
server   | create session session_id=sess-78 token=rt_Zx12
```

vijay: So server sees two init events with same resume token because QUIC stream remapping happens and the prior session didn't get tombstoned. Do we have session tombstones TTL?

sam: We do, but it was 300s. That long TTL means rapid reconnects look like new sessions. Plus because QUIC tear-down is soft we don't always get a close event.

aline: Short-term mitigation: introduce short idempotency window for init tokens on the session-manager (e.g., 60s) and emit metric `stream.session.phantom` when we detect >1 active session with same token. Also add console annotation so product dashboards exclude phantoms.

vijay: Agree. Add server header `X-Session-Dedup: true` when we attach to an existing session. For safety, reattach should be read-only until we validate the client `last_ack`. If `last_ack` mismatches we fallback to full init.

ops-bot: Deployment started: sam/session-dedupe-quic -> canary eu-2.

sam: Canary (3m): `stream.session.phantom` spiked (expected) on canary nodes, and real user-visible session count dropped by ~60% for affected clients. No CPU memory regressions.

aline: Good. Follow-ups: (1) Dashboard tile `Sessions -> show/hide phantom sessions` (console-bot filed) (2) RFC for QUIC session semantics and recommended tombstone TTL (vijay to author) (3) Runbook snippet for oncall to detect QUIC spin-down vs normal FIN.

console-bot: Created ticket CONS-2120 to add session filter and hide phantom sessions on product dashboards.

vijay: I'll write RFC: https://go/redwood/rfc/quic-session-tombstones - proposing default tombstone=60s and idempotency-window=75s.

sam: Also we should add alert: `stream.session.phantom > 20/min` per region -> page infra. I can add Grafana panel.

aline: Note: long-term we should consider aligning QUIC path-close signals with our proxy so we generate a deterministic close event (like explicit `:close` control frame) so clients attempt resume instead of opening fresh session. I'll add a proxy RFC.

ops-bot: Canary deployed: sam/session-dedupe-quic -> eu-2.

sam: Will promote after 30m stable. Closing thread if no regressions.
